header: CHARACTERIZATION — records CURRENT behaviour, not desired behaviour.

caseIndex.description: P1 (Hunt) and E1 both Move toward the same tile from 6 tiles apart; two ticks of simultaneous movement/collision resolution.
Adjacent P1 vs E1 over three ticks: P1 defends vs attack (reduced), both attack (full), E1 defends vs attack (reduced).
P1 and P2 kill the 1-HP E1/E2 in tick 1; the pack (E3 survives) is replanned mid-turn (known H1 behaviour, recorded not judged).
Both sides' last units (1 HP each) attack each other in one tick; devTest.runTurn then concludes the battle (defeat is checked first).
Seed-1 intro, real executePlayerActionQueue x2: first three hand cards (by index) to P1/P2/P3, wounded P2 heals at turn end, hand refills, enemy preview replans.
1-HP E1 (the only enemy) is killed by P1 (1 HP) and P2 attacking it; it dies in tick 1 and the real turn path concludes the battle (result overlay, win message).
1-HP E1 flees from P1 (turn 1 ends at distance 5, beyond the trigger range of 4 yet still fleeing), keeps fleeing in turn 2 (distance 2) and stops only at distance 7 (the safe range) after turn 3.
Smoke trace: untouched seed-1 intro board, one real turn with hand-chosen cards (P1 cards 0,1; P2 card 2; P3 card 0 by index).
